title: Alignment Helper
prompt: Implement `unsigned char *align_up(unsigned char *p, size_t align)` returning the smallest address >= p that is a multiple of align (align is a power of two). This is the helper every arena needs before handing out typed slices.

tests.name: rounds up
tests.hint: Offset 3 rounds to the next multiple of 8.

tests.name: already aligned
tests.hint: A multiple stays put — no gratuitous bump.

tests.name: align 1 identity
